title: Flamingo reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- flamingo body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='62' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#ff7eb6'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='60' rx='16' ry='10' fill='#ff9ecb'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M 40 54 Q 34 40 34 30 Q 34 20 42 18' stroke='#ff7eb6' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 40 54 Q 34 40 34 30 Q 34 20 42 18' stroke='#ff9ecb' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='17' r='7' fill='#ff7eb6'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='16' r='5' fill='#ffb3d6'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M 50 17 Q 57 16 56 21 Q 52 21 50 19 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M 50 19 Q 55 19 56 21 Q 52 21 50 20 Z' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='15' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='42' y1='74' x2='40' y2='92' stroke='#ff5ba3' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='74' x2='54' y2='92' stroke='#ff5ba3' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M 54 92 L 48 94 M 54 92 L 59 94' stroke='#ff5ba3' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book held in front -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 62 66)'>
    <path d='M 56 58 L 56 78 L 66 74 L 66 56 Z' fill='#5ac8e8'/>
    <path d='M 66 56 L 66 74 L 76 78 L 76 58 Z' fill='#8ee0f5'/>
    <path d='M 56 58 L 66 56 L 76 58 L 66 60 Z' fill='#c8f0ff'/>
    <!-- page lines -->
    <line x1='59' y1='62' x2='64' y2='61' stroke='#2a7a9a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='59' y1='66' x2='64' y2='65' stroke='#2a7a9a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='59' y1='70' x2='64' y2='69' stroke='#2a7a9a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='61' x2='73' y2='62' stroke='#2a7a9a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='65' x2='73' y2='66' stroke='#2a7a9a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='69' x2='73' y2='70' stroke='#2a7a9a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- wing tip on book -->
  <path d='M 46 58 Q 52 57 57 60 Q 51 62 46 60 Z' fill='#ff5ba3'/>
</svg>
